approved_payload.content: Eight men were found shot dead inside a white seven-seater vehicle riddled with bullet holes at the Mabane section of Sweetwaters, outside Pietermaritzburg, on the night of Sunday 15 November, KwaZulu-Natal police spokesperson Col Robert Netshiunda told IOL. MDNtv reports that police later said the vehicle was used for e-hailing, that two firearms, 14 rounds and a blank gun were found in it, and that six of the men, aged 20 to 30, had been identified. Police had not established how it happened or the motive, and no arrests were reported. The map point is approximate: a point on the road towards Sweetwaters, not the scene.
